description: Erection of garden room (see submitted planning statement)
decision_conditions: <p><span id="docs-internal-guid-f28b7c0a-7fff-5342-c303-59ae9dc7deab"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.2; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 6pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">The proposal, by reason of its proximity to nearby trees and lack of a tree survey, fails to demonstrate that the proposal would have an acceptable impact on the crowns and root protection zones of these trees. </span>The local planning authority is therefore unable to fully assess the merits or otherwise of this proposal, contrary to policies LP1 (Design Quality and Local Character), LP3 (Designated Heritage Assets), LP46 (<span id="docs-internal-guid-2b69685d-7fff-2095-8001-94a83cbbb133"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">Protecting and Enhancement of Green Infrastructure)</span></span>, LP47 (<span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">Biodiversity and Sites of Importance of Nature Conservation)</span> and LP51 (Tree Management and Landscaping) of the Hackney Local Plan LP33 (2020) and policies G1 (Green infrastructure), G6 (<span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">Biodiversity and access to nature) </span>G7 (<span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">Trees and woodlands</span>) and HC1 (Heritage conservation and growth) of the London Plan (2021).&nbsp;</p><p dir="ltr" style="text-align: left; line-height: 1.2; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 6pt;"><span id="docs-internal-guid-88e2e934-7fff-fec7-1bda-afa46cc933e5"></span></p>

<p><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">The proposed development, by reason of its size and footprint and detailed design, would result in an incompatible form of development which would fail to preserve or enhance the character and appearance of the Clissold Park</span><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;"> C</span><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">onservation Area, through the incremental urbanisation of the rear garden area within the conservation area. As such, the proposed development is contrary to policies LP1 (Design quality and local character), LP3 (Designated Heritage Assets) of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 (2020), and policies D3 (Optimising site capacity through the design-led approach), D4 (Delivering good design), and </span>HC1 (Heritage conservation and growth) London Plan (2021) and Hackney's Residential Extensions and Alterations SPD (2009).</p><p><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: transparent; font-family: Arial; vertical-align: baseline;"><span id="docs-internal-guid-b6ad8096-7fff-b3b2-55d7-0d5210486cda"></span><br></span></p>
